text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf blows the competition<n>away and
takes first place. Her<n>performance bodes well for
the<n>Satsuki Sho, although it seems to<n>have
intimidated the general manager.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Symboli Rudolf<n>encounters
Maruzensky, the "Beast."<n>Much like Rudolf,
Maruzensky's<n>formidable skills have made her the
talk of the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Could this potential rivalry bring out a<n>new side of
Symboli Rudolf? I can't<n>help but wonder what the
future might<n>hold.
